\definecolor{brandink}{HTML}{16181D}
\definecolor{brandblue}{HTML}{3C6BF0}
\definecolor{muted}{HTML}{5B6069}
\definecolor{line}{HTML}{D9D9D2}
\definecolor{link}{HTML}{2A55D6}
\definecolor{soft}{HTML}{E6ECFD}
\definecolor{shadecolor}{HTML}{F4F4F0}
\AtBeginDocument{\hypersetup{linkcolor=link, urlcolor=link, citecolor=link, filecolor=link}}

\newfontfamily\displayfont{Inter Display}[Numbers=Lining]

\setkomafont{disposition}{\displayfont\bfseries\color{brandink}}
\setkomafont{chapter}{\fontsize{26}{31}\selectfont}
\setkomafont{section}{\fontsize{14.5}{19}\selectfont}
\setkomafont{subsection}{\fontsize{11.5}{15}\selectfont}
\setkomafont{subsubsection}{\normalsize}
\setkomafont{part}{\fontsize{34}{40}\selectfont}
\setkomafont{partnumber}{}
\setkomafont{chapterentry}{\displayfont\bfseries}
\setkomafont{pageheadfoot}{\footnotesize\color{muted}}
\setkomafont{pagenumber}{\footnotesize\color{muted}}
\setkomafont{caption}{\small\color{muted}}
\setkomafont{captionlabel}{\small\bfseries\color{brandink}}
\setkomafont{descriptionlabel}{\bfseries}

\renewcommand*{\chapterformat}{\textcolor{brandblue}{\thechapter}\hspace{0.45em}}
\renewcommand*{\sectionformat}{\textcolor{brandblue}{\thesection}\hspace{0.6em}}
\renewcommand*{\subsectionformat}{\textcolor{brandblue}{\thesubsection}\hspace{0.6em}}
\renewcommand*{\partformat}{{\normalsize\mdseries\color{brandblue}\addfontfeature{LetterSpace=8}\MakeUppercase{\partname~\thepart}}}
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=0pt, afterskip=28pt]{chapter}
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=-26pt plus -4pt, afterskip=10pt]{section}
\RedeclareSectionCommand[beforeskip=-18pt plus -3pt, afterskip=6pt]{subsection}

\usepackage{scrlayer-scrpage}
\clearpairofpagestyles
\automark[chapter]{chapter}
\ohead{\pagemark}
\ihead{\headmark}
\setlength{\footheight}{14pt}

\usepackage{framed}
\makeatletter
\renewenvironment{Shaded}{\setlength{\FrameSep}{7pt}\begin{snugshade}\small}{\end{snugshade}}
\renewcommand{\maketitle}{%
  \begin{titlepage}
    \vspace*{38mm}
    \includegraphics[width=68mm]{logo/lockup.pdf}\par
    \vspace{20mm}
    {\displayfont\bfseries\fontsize{22}{28}\selectfont\color{brandink}\@subtitle\par}
    \vspace{6mm}
    {\large\color{muted}User guide, method and reference\par}
    \vfill
    {\color{brandblue}\rule{18mm}{2.5pt}}\par
  \end{titlepage}}
\makeatother

\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.25}
\AtBeginDocument{\urlstyle{same}}
\setlength{\LTleft}{0pt}
\setlength{\LTright}{\fill}
